notes.title: NEW DEMO, NEW TRAILER, NEW BLOOD 🩸
notes.notes:
[h3]A scary Halloween for Tenebris Somnia approaches! 🎃 [/h3]

During 2024 we have been doing dozens of filming sessions and making intense progress with the development of the game. But not only that, we expanded our film crew and also made new partners...


[h3][b]THE UNHOLY ALLIANCE[/b][/h3]

One of the most important publishers of indie games during the last decade will now be in charge of distributing our title. We are talking about [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/NewBlood]New Blood Interactive[/url][/b], the guys behind great hits like DUSK, AMID EVIL, Gloomwood, Fallen Aces and ULTRAKILL.

But that's not all... Airdorf, the creator of the terrifying [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1179080/FAITH_The_Unholy_Trinity/][b]FAITH: The Unholy Trinity[/b][/url][/i], will now serve as the Executive Producer of Tenebris Somnia! MORTIS ✝

[previewyoutube=UuvcepjC_dg;full][NEW BLOOD AND AIRDORF LOGOS][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]THE CINEMATICS[/b][/h3]

Last month we had our biggest filming sessions to date. We built our own set inside a huge warehouse. It was a full week of shooting with more than thirty film specialists involved, including actors, technicians and production staff 🎥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/3ff23d49a522f0dbd1feb3251008264d3f1559ab.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/42e07c3d312722ff46ceb5f500b5e1b1afdea693.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/be61d8dd665f3ea263be5ce2b7abd71378e6d34c.jpg[/img]
We also had other film sessions at the beginning and middle of the year. With everything done to date, we could say that we have already filmed more than 60% of the game's story so far.


[h3][b]THE GAME[/b][/h3]

Game development also continues progressing strongly. New scenarios, enemies, items and weapons are already part of the current game 🕹️

That’s why we decided to expand the playable demo so that you can taste a little more of what is coming in the final release, which we hope to achieve by the end of 2025.

[b]And here are a couple of new screenshots:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/73b0d13d21f8503016bd04307b8b6f13d98a2606.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/0df8834506ddfa9a3f20f632234eb76276e4eb9b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/f450c07a19967eedfd2f99911fca2dc5944c78f4.jpg[/img]

[b]But this is still only a small part of what is to come…[/b]

Incredible things continue to happen in the development of Tenebris Somnia, although we can't reveal more for now, we hope you enjoy the new demo and don't forget to tell us about it, what you liked and what you think we could improve on 🙌

Follow us on the game's official networks on [url=https://x.com/TenebrisSomnia][b]Twitter[/b][/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/tenebrissomnia_game/][b]Instagram[/b][/url] to keep up to date with more news and curiosities from behind the scenes...

Cheers from Team Somnia, and thanks for your support!

[i][url=https://x.com/TobiasRusjan]Tobías[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/borghiandres/]Andrés[/url][/i]

notes.title: DEMO, SHOOTING SESSIONS, EVENTS AND MORE 🏆
notes.notes:
[b]Big news for Tenebris Somnia![/b]

Incredible things have been going on with the project since our last post we made last year.

We released a demo together with a new trailer, [url=https://twitter.com/TenebrisSomnia/status/1700198445745627443]which went viral on Twitter[/url]! We did the first definitive shooting sessions for the cinematics of the game. And we also won the biggest prize a game can get in our country!

We’ll tell you everything about that and much more in this post.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/9194b1759dc0f823e44971410a13a89971a94e81.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [i]New logo designed by [url=https://www.instagram.com/scuzzostuff/]Claudio ”Scuzzo” Sagrera[/url][/i]
[/list]

[h3][b]THE SHOOTING SESSIONS[/b][/h3]

To start off, at the beginning of 2023 we got a [url=https://www.unrealengine.com/en-US/megagrants]Mega Grant[/url] from Epic Games. This has helped us a lot to keep working on the project without needing to use our savings 💸

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/0734720d13e0aeabb385d962e3b6f6f4c3a66339.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [i]Picture: [url=https://www.instagram.com/claramkovacic/]Clara Kovacic[/url] as “Julia”[/i]
[/list]

Thanks to this support, during the months of April and May we were able to shoot the first definitive sessions for the movies of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/3cc9f5aa839c91f1cfb782ddcd38925a47e4dc66.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [i][url=https://www.instagram.com/borghiandres/]Andrés Borghi[/url] (game director) and [url=https://www.instagram.com/matias_rispau/]Matías Rispau[/url] (director of photography and camera)[/i]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/b2e986913d0337b42754d4fe359f41d68d924df7.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [i]First monster’s mask created by [url=https://www.instagram.com/marcosbertastudio/]Marcos Berta Studio[/url][/i]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/b775db1b8dfa7d0d66b9659b2e93bde0c6fac539.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [i][url=https://www.instagram.com/hugoius/]Hugo Caceres[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/juan.ponja.lopez/]Juan Lopez[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/borghiandres/]Andrés Borghi[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/matias_rispau/]Matías Rispau[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/amandanarax/]Amanda Nara[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/juliporki/]Juli Quiroga[/url][/i]
[/list]

They were three intense (but super fun) working days with a lot of movie professionals, including actors, scenography, make-up, special effects, cameras, lighting, among others.

And right now, we’re preparing the second part of the definitive film sessions for the end of the year, where we’re looking to complete a very important part of the story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/34eba9092f9534d408c4a8db7657bfc51ff5c0fc.jpg[/img]

[*] [i]Picture by [url=https://www.instagram.com/juan.ponja.lopez/]Juan Lopez[/url]. [/list]

[h3][b]THE DEV TEAM[/b][/h3]

In terms of the game itself, we continue working with the unmatched team of graphic artists: El Toreh as concept artist and illustrator, Attar doing most of the pixel art and Pedrito Caval in pixel art and animations for characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/e52b31901f87c96403dcec1b9192e0fdf6ef2e39.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [i]Left to right: [url=https://www.instagram.com/el_toreh/]El Toreh[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/attar_px/]Attar[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/pedritocaval/]Pedrito Caval[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/borghiandres/]Andrés Borghi[/url] y [url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan]Tobías Rusjan[/url][/i]
[/list]

But this time, a well know friend of us joined the team: David Levill, the music producer and sound designer from our games [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/383930/Doorways_Holy_Mountains_of_Flesh/]Doorways[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/753590/Hellbound/]Hellbound[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1787100/Out_of_Bounds/]Out of Bounds[/url]; and the guy who did the remaster of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431780/The_Black_Heart/]The Black Heart[/url] soundtrack.

For Tenebris Somnia, David is doing the music and sound effects for the 8-bit version 👾

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/0bd848840133477db53b9c35c54d5e167873d590.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [i][url=https://twitter.com/davyd_music]David Levill[/url] at his studio in Santa Cruz, Río Gallegos (Argentina)[/i]
[/list]


[h3][b]PLAYABLE DEMO[/b][/h3]

This month of September 2023 was without a doubt the most important month for Tenebris Somnia to date.

After working for more than a year on the project, both in development and making the movies, we finally launched a playable demo of the game so everybody can taste a small bit of what this dark and twisted survival horror adventure is all about.

Didn’t try the demo yet? Go to the next link and find the big green button to start the download 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2121510/Tenebris_Somnia/

Since the release of the demo, we have been reading and listening to every opinion and feedback you gave us. Even though the reception was great in general, there were some things to fix and improve. So we have made a quick update to the demo including some changes based on your feedback. You can find the full list on the bottom of this post 🗒️

Don’t stop letting us know about what you think! You can use the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2121510/discussions/]Steam discussion section[/url] for that.


[h3][b]FEAR FEST AND TRAILER[/b][/h3]

We launched the demo together with a new trailer which was broadcasted for the first time at the event [url=https://fearfest.online/]Fear Fest: Black Summer 2023[/url] hosted by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/feardemic/]Feardemic[/url] and featured at the [url=https://www.youtube.com/live/3kMdq9k00U0?si=5FJU5hHEfLTQ04aq]IGN official channels[/url]. The new trailer is short, but super intense, and shows new characters, locations, mechanics and (above everything) a lot of horror:

[url=https://youtu.be/MPpTPF_k6hY?si=hF0oJLK1RTJbeVa-][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/2b3fc6bb91993d8512dc3b3145c7bee85696e64c.jpg[/img][/url]
[list]
[*] [i][url=https://youtu.be/MPpTPF_k6hY?si=hF0oJLK1RTJbeVa-]Watch the trailer[/url]. Picture: [url=https://www.instagram.com/meugenia.rigon/]María Eugenia Rigon[/url] as “Vitria”[/i]
[/list]

During the event, there was also a special interview with the game director Andrés Borghi. You can watch it in the link below:

https://youtu.be/3FNLzRIgx6E?si=sBy3Wb9EYpLgptmp


Both the demo and the trailer traveled through the internet all around the world. From the dev team, we were shocked with the impact and reception the game had. The news came out on big sites like 
[url=https://www.pcgamer.com/my-new-greatest-fear-is-meeting-the-two-faced-monster-from-this-survival-horror-game-that-combines-retro-pixel-art-with-fmv/]PC Gamer[/url], [url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/tenebris-somnia-is-an-8-bit-horror-adventure-with-a-flashy-twist]RPS[/url], [url=https://vandal.elespanol.com/noticia/1350765413/asi-es-tenebris-somnia-un-original-y-aterrador-survival-horror-argentino/]Vandal[/url], [url=https://as.com/meristation/noticias/tenebris-somnia-un-survival-horror-que-combina-sus-8-bits-con-escenas-de-accion-real-n/]Meristation[/url] and [url=https://bloody-disgusting.com/video-games/3778608/upcoming-8-bit-game-tenebris-somnia-combines-cool-aesthetics-with-traditional-survival-horror-gameplay-trailer/]Bloody Disgusting[/url]; but the demo was also played by big influencers from different parts of globe 🤯


[h3][b]EVA AND RECOGNITION[/b][/h3]

A week after the big announcement, we participated in the most important local event of game development here in Argentina: EVA 2023. We were there with the team presenting an extended version of the demo of Tenebris Somnia so people from our country could check the new mechanics and cinematics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/a4bc720c7d17f5504ffd3bb5ece65a86355c7db2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/6929d3a5bd47813b34e778e595e8d7d437a6c3f4.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/861368215d9ccf15bc93b2fd657ca332324ccc44.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [i][url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan/status/1705634158339293186]See more pictures from the event[/url][/i]
[/list]

The feedback was great once again. And thanks to the people who visited our stand, we were able to fix and improve different things for the game.

And to close this lovely month of ”Septembris”, the game won the prise Best Game EVA 2023, the biggest award of the event. 🏆

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/f383e617eedbfe7055f726a977fb23b194b25cb5.gif[/img]
[list]

[h3][b]REALMS DEEP[/b][/h3]

And speaking of events, we’re right now participating for the second consecutive years in the online event [url=https://www.realmsdeep.game/]Realms Deep 2023[/url], hosted by the guys at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/3DREALMS/]3D Realms[/url] 🙌

Don’t miss all the sales of great indie games with retro vibes! Also, tomorrow (Saturday 30th), a broadcast will start with announcements of new titles and interviews to the developers. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/RealmsDeep2023]Check everything here![/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/RealmsDeep2023][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/0c80d5890fcb6a83692a42f8c151bfb6d5900189.png[/img][/url]

To finish, we want to share with you how happy we are right now with everything that has been going on with Tenebris Somnia. There’s still a lot to do, but we have all the motivation in the world right now. Thank you for that!

Below are some new screenshots from the game and on the very bottom of this post is the changelog of the demo update. Don’t forget to leave your feedback!

A big hug from the team! Thank you once again for all the support and stay tunned for more news and behind the scenes material at our accounts in [url=https://twitter.com/TenebrisSomnia]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/tenebrissomnia_game/]Instagram[/url] 👌

Cheers, everybody!

[i]Tobías and Andrés[/i]

notes.title: Tenebris Somnia is an 8-bit horror adventure with a flashy twist
notes.notes:
Some would say the best way to wind down after a rough day down the Content Reactors isn’t to play a grotty occult horror game, but I caught a trailer for Tenebris Somnia earlier, and couldn’t help myself. In this foetid offering from Argentinian devs Andrés Borghi and Tobías Rusjan of Saibot Studios, you play a young woman, Julia, who is visiting her film-maker ex-boyfriend to drop off their old apartment key. Julia’s having a hard time getting over the break-up, but she’s clearly doing better than her ex: his apartment is full of broken glass, anomalous red gloop and creepy occult books.

The game’s twist is that it’s two visual styles thrust into the same frame. On the one hand, you'll explore an 8-bit world of unpleasantly bright colours, finding and combining objects adventure-game-style. I say adventure-game-style, because this is a bit more energetic than most adventure games – you can equip and swing a wrench, and there’s a run button. On the other hand, well. Click the headline to find out, if you dare. Yes, this is me trying to do a jumpscare. Brace yourself! (It's just occurred to me, 24 hours too late, that the above joke only makes sense if you're viewing our Latest feed. Everybody else, erm - scroll down?)

notes.title: 🚨 New game Out of Bounds is NOW AVAILABLE! 🚨
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, everybody! How have you been?[/b]

We're doing PRETTY WELL! Closing this crazy 2022 celebrating 🥳

And that's not only because [url=https://edition.cnn.com/2022/12/20/sport/argentina-football-team-arrival-intl-hnk-spt]our football team won the World Cup[/url], but also because we have just released a new game on Steam:

[url=https://youtu.be/U7Q1M-wRbMg][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/53ceb798e992c68ae96c207c36012d92b474fc5d.png[/img][/url]

Out of Bounds is a peculiar title that was originally created for a game jam the past year ([url=https://itch.io/jam/2021-epic-megajam]Epic Megajam 2021[/url]). As a solo dev, I had 7 days to create a game that was later [url=https://tobiasrusjan.itch.io/out-of-bounds]released for free on Itchio[/url].

Since I liked the result of the jam, I decided to keep working on that idea for the next months and also some great devs (former colleagues from other projects) joined me to get the best results in visuals ([url=https://twitter.com/viktorahmed]Viktor Ahmed[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/scuzzostuff/]Claudio "Scuzzo" Sagrera[/url]) and audio ([url=https://twitter.com/davyd_music]David Levill[/url]) 🙌



[h1]THE GAME[/h1]

Out of Bounds is a title about "creating" a game and "fixing" bugs... Yeah, it's crazy. You will pickup blueprints, compile shaders, test sound effects, drink a lot of coffee. But watch out for the bugs! Grab your Line Tracer and get rid of them 👾

https://youtu.be/U7Q1M-wRbMg
Things are starting to get better here in Saibot Studios and Out of Bounds is part of that process. I'm looking forward to bring you news about bigger projects in the future, but for now give a chance to this crazy puzzle shooter with humor and puzzles 🤓

You can follow Out of Bounds on its new Twitter account:
https://twitter.com/OutOfBoundsVg



[h1]NEWS ABOUT EXPLOSIONS AND GORE?[/h1]

Hell yeah! The people at [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/]Humble Bundle[/url] created [url=https://www.humblebundle.com/games/holiday-encore-best-boomer-shooters-bundle]a new package of retro style first person shooters[/url] based on the one they did in March of this year 🔥

[url=https://www.humblebundle.com/games/holiday-encore-best-boomer-shooters-bundle][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/d71afde69b8306dbbb108c8e6fbcb9e42f3a60d0.png[/img][/url]

This time, you can get 7 awesome titles for only 12 dollars, including our own [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/753590/Hellbound/]Hellbound[/url] and the great [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1590910/Forgive_Me_Father/]Forgive Me Father[/url] was also added to the list.

A percentage of the sales will go to charity at [url=https://ablegamers.org/]Able Gamers[/url] and [url=https://www.starlight.org/]Starlight Children's Foundation[/url] ❤️

Hurry up! Get the bundle before the next 24 hours ⏲️



If you have a Twitter account, don't forget to follow us for more news:
https://twitter.com/SaibotStudios

Cheers and take care!

[url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan][i]Tobías[/i][/url]

notes.title: 📦 COLLECTION + SPECIAL VIDEO + MORE! 🪙
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28189/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/2baf71e0692653c469784f5518da8d0bd44810da.png[/img][/url]


[h1]Hello there! How are you? How's your 2022 so far? 😎[/h1]

From here, we have a few things to tell you...

As we mentioned you in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/SaibotStudios/announcements/detail/3123813809682672635]last post[/url], this year we reached an entire decade since we started making games as an independent team in Saibot Studios. But it was just now that we actually make something special to celebrate it. [url=https://youtu.be/S4-E40ce_Oo]Check out the special video![/url]

https://youtu.be/S4-E40ce_Oo

Together with this video, we built and launched a collection with all our published games, including: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/search/?franchise=Doorways]the Doorways saga[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/753590/Hellbound/]Hellbound[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431780/The_Black_Heart/]The Black Heart[/url] 😈

[b]> [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28189/]LINK TO BUNDLE[/url] <[/b]

Buying the games from the bundle, gives you a 15% of discount on all the titles. And if you already have one or more of the games included in the package, it will discount you the titles you're missing without needing to buy the entire bundle 👌



[h1]TENEBRIS SOMNIA[/h1]

On the other hand, we receently announced our new creation: Tenebris Somnia. This is a very unique title by the great [url=https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andr%C3%A9s_Borghi]Andrés Borghi[/url], creator of The Black Heart 🖤

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2121510/Tenebris_Somnia/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/3dc732cee7c111bb33503e507a649dcf3d66ae79.png[/img][/url]

We're developing this project Andrés and I ([url=https://twitter.com/TobiasRusjan]Tobías Rusjan[/url]), together with a great team of artists. You can read more about it and the dev team [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2121510/view/3307354336731266403]in this other post[/url] we did the past week.

If you like the concept of the game, don't forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2121510/Tenebris_Somnia/]add it to your Wishlists[/url]. We're aiming to have it ready during 2023 👍

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2121510/Tenebris_Somnia/



[h1]OUT OF BOUNDS[/h1]

In the mean time, I keep working on my little jam game Out of Bounds, a rare title with action, shooting and puzzles. We released a demo in June and it's still available to check directly from the store page:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1787100/Out_of_Bounds/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/53ceb798e992c68ae96c207c36012d92b474fc5d.png[/img][/url]

My idea is finish the full game for the end of the year. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1787100/Out_of_Bounds/]So play the demo and add it to your wishlist if you liked it![/url] 🙌

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1787100/Out_of_Bounds/



[h1]HELLBOUND... HELLBOUND?[/h1]

This month we received the great news from our (now) former publishers that they're giving us back the IP of Hellbound 🤯

What does this mean?

Finally, we at Saibot Studios are going to start receiving sales from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/753590/Hellbound/]Hellbound[/url] on Steam. Since the release of 2020, all the sales went to the publisher because that was what we stablished: they recoup their investment first, and then we split; but we never reached that last step because they never recoup their part with the sales we had.

But now after two years from the release, they're giving us back the game so we can atleast see some of the sales. Also, we got back the full rights of the project to take any desision we want from now on 🔥

[url=https://youtu.be/ndqIlyYFVJM][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/5d56edecbe4128de8d9912896496161a814e16f3.png[/img][/url]

In March of this year there was the Best of Boomer Shooters Bundle, the first collection of Humble Bundle focused on retro FPSs. Hellbound had the honour to be included in that package, becoming the first argentinian game in participate in the iconic Humble Bundle:

https://youtu.be/ndqIlyYFVJM

Both the sales from this collection and also the sales from now on (September of 2022) at Steam are going to us at Saibot. Yes, finally!

But unfortunately, this aren't earnings for us yet, since we still need to recoup all we put to create the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/802200/Hellbound_Survival_Mode/]Hellbound: Survival Mode[/url] in 2016-2018.

So the future of Hellbound is still uncertain... The good thing is that everything has started looking brighter now, we'll see how things turn for our Hellgore in the next months 🤞



That would be all for now, people. Hope we have some more news for you soon, follow us in our networks to stay updated:
[list]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/SaibotStudios]Twitter [/url]
[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/saibotstudios/]Instagram [/url]
[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/SaibotStudios]Facebook[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCa29sOnJRNG-ZLGU2GfNNow]You Tube[/url]
[/list]

Cheers, everybody! Take care!

[i]Tobias[/i]

notes.title: WELCOME 👁️
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

Here are [url=https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andr%C3%A9s_Borghi]Andrés Borghi[/url] (creative director and screenplay) and [url=http://saibotstudios.com/]Tobías Rusjan[/url] (project director and programmer) ✊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/1a241f23e210b9ac7226612f5ed5eb40da5d3951.jpg[/img]
[list][*][i]Tobías (left) and Andrés (right). Picture by [url=https://www.instagram.com/voltamr.ok/]Voltaire Musso Rovitti[/url][/i][/list]


Tenebris Somnia is a survival horror in the vein of old-school classic Resident Evil and Silent Hill games, but set in a 2D environment, with pixel art 8-bit visuals 👾

The distinctive feature that makes Tenebris Somnia stand out from other games is the cutscenes. As you progress in the game, you will come across movies filmed with live-action actors in a real life set. This creates a huge contrast of styles never seen before, increasing the sense of strangeness and terror…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/a8e62a65e980c31f4f503932469371d15e7c6d46.png[/img]
[list][*][i][url=https://youtu.be/2MQKCLvjtgU]Watch the teaser trailer on YouTube[/url]. Actress: [url=https://www.instagram.com/claramkovacic/]Clara Kovacic[/url][/i][/list]


The Tenebris Somnia project is an idea by Andrés developed together with Tobías and a great team of artists: [url=https://www.instagram.com/attar_px/]Attar[/url] (main pixel artist), [url=https://www.instagram.com/el_toreh/]El Toreh[/url] (concept artist) and [url=https://www.instagram.com/pedritocaval/]Pedro Caval[/url] (character animator) 🙌

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/a50a2b9c97156d24e1169b656aec60d98b1109b2.jpg[/img]
[list][*][i]Left to right: El Toreh, Andrés, Attar, Pedro and Tobías[/i][/list]


The past week was the EVA 2022, the biggest annual event about game development here in Argentina. During the event, we showcased a very early version of the game for the first time so people who attended the expo could play it 🕹

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42924291/056aa45e7c84ac128523caf5817d0fff1d447c8d.jpg[/img]


The reception of the game was EXCELLENT! Thanks to you, we know what to fix and improve in order to reach the best game results 👌

But this has just begun! There’s still a lot of work to do and right now we’re looking for fundings and publishers interested in helping us out to make the full project a reality.

In the meantime, we’ll continue working and keep you updated on our social networks. Follow us!
